name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads Christensen's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly after a successful career in corporate accounting. A chance encounter with a race team owner at a local business networking event sparked his interest. Intrigued by the financial complexities and high-stakes environment of racing, he transitioned his skills to the motorsport world. He quickly found his niche, bringing a meticulous and analytical approach to managing team budgets and ensuring financial stability.

At Team Penske, Mads is known for his calm demeanor and ability to navigate the pressures of race weekends and tight deadlines. He emphasizes transparency and collaboration, fostering strong working relationships with engineers, mechanics, and management. His deep understanding of financial regulations and his proactive approach to risk management are invaluable assets to the team. Mads distinguishes himself through his commitment to continuous improvement, always seeking innovative financial strategies to enhance the team's competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium height with a slightly stocky build, he always carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small pocket calculator, even though he uses spreadsheets extensively.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of green tea, which he brews in his office every afternoon.
